title: Global Trade Compliance Counsel
jobDescription:
Job Title: Ethics & Compliance, Global Trade Compliance Counsel Career Level: Manager/CL7 Career Track: Corporate Function Skill Track: Legal Job Summary: We are hiring a Trade Compliance lawyer, with 3–5+ years’ experience as a lawyer focused on trade compliance law, to serve as a subject matter expert supporting trade compliance activities under the direction of senior trade compliance leadership. Global Trade Compliance Counsel plays an important part in promoting Accenture’s compliance with international trade control requirements and regulations in the countries where Accenture does business and helps our Legal team and business to understand trade and export control related risks, compliance, and program controls. This role is an execution‑focused position that operates under the supervision and direction of the Senior Trade Compliance Counsel, Americas Lead. The role supports business stakeholders on transactional trade compliance matters in client contracts and trade‑related reviews of the company’s services and offerings, and is responsible for developing and delivering relevant trade compliance training and awareness materials, as well as tools, templates, resources, and guidance materials in alignment with established global program guidance. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Supports the implementation and maintenance of Accenture’s trade compliance program initiatives across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions, executing defined activities and priorities set by global and regional trade compliance leadership, including: Development and delivery of trade compliance training using approved content and frameworks. Development, review and implementation of trade policies and internal controls to support existing program requirements, subject to review and approval by senior trade compliance counsel. Planning and drafting trade compliance communications with internal stakeholders to reinforce existing policies, guidance, and escalation pathways. Working with senior management and outside counsel to conduct risk assessments, recommend improvements to the trade compliance program, and support the implementation of adopted recommendations. Working with internal stakeholders to build trade compliance and monitoring tools to escalate and mitigate trade-related risks. Working with Export Control Officers, including the Export Control Officer in India, on specialized regulated export matters. Provides objective, focused, practical advice and solutions to Accenture businesses and Legal Professionals regarding compliance with trade/export laws, Accenture’s Code of Business Ethics, Accenture’s trade compliance policies, and all other related policies. Collaborates with Legal colleagues and the business to identify, analyze and mitigate trade-related risks, and conducts localized training on trade/export law issues. Responds to and helps manage internal audits and internal investigations related to trade/export law issues. Key Relationships: Reports to: Senior Trade Compliance Counsel, Americas Lead Other Key Relationships: Legal, including Global Services Legal, Sales & Delivery, Contracting, Geographic Compliance and Corporate Counsel. Corporate Functions and business stakeholders. Market Unit leadership. Related subject matter experts (e.g., analytics, security professionals, government compliance). Privacy professionals at client and peer companies. Outside counsel/external law firms.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Juris Doctorate degree (or comparable legal Master’s degree) and an admitted lawyer. Work Requirements: Limited travel required as needed (usually <10%). Must have ability to effectively work with others remotely, manage a schedule with global clients and engage in contract negotiation. Knowledge and Skill Requirements: Demonstrated knowledge of international trade controls and trade/export regulatory systems around the world, including U.S. export controls. Experience supporting compliance programs, including preparing policies and internal controls; developing and conducting training; responding to government inquiries; and drafting and reviewing contracts. Ability to prioritize tasks and synthesize complex legal analysis into clear, practical recommendations. Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills with the ability to interface, and develop relationships, with all levels of management and staff, and work cross-culturally. Confidence and credibility in dealing with internal management and personnel at client and peer companies. Highly motivated and proactive, with the ability to articulate company vision and policy, and to seek out areas of risk and priority. Strong writing and negotiation skills. Ability to consistently apply good judgment and prioritize. Adapts nimbly to changing needs within the business. Fluent in English. Additional Desirable Criteria: Chinese language skills. title: Contract Associate Manager
jobDescription:
Contract Management is part of our Legal and Commercial Services. Our professionals bring innovative ideas to commercial reality with a focus on maximizing value for all parties through a deep understanding of legal, business and commercial risks. We work alongside Accenture sales and delivery teams throughout the entire contract lifecycle to provide high quality advice and support for negotiation, drafting and ongoing management of client contracts. We apply commercial and contractual expertise to lead the delivery of legal & commercial outcomes for our priority engagements and portfolios, including: · Sales growth: expanding the footprint of our agreements and supporting new business; · Revenue protection: delivering on our contractual commitments; · Margin improvement: effectively managing commercial levers, risks and issues; and · Compliance with contract obligations and Accenture policy. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
· Lead/support contract management teams across projects and accounts; work with account leadership, client commercial and business stakeholders to understand and support client needs and priorities; account strategy, objectives and opportunities. · Work with contract management staff across multiple projects and accounts providing input into performance management activities. · Support the identification, escalation and resolution of commercial and contract risks and issues working with CM and project leadership to ensure the best outcome for all parties. · Engage in pre-award sales activities, engage in discussions with delivery team regarding potential deal shaping and contractual outcomes with sales teams and business leadership, including contract drafting support. · The contract management function is client facing and has a key role in building trusted relationships with client counterparts.

title: Buyside Contracting Counsel Manager
jobDescription:
Global Legal Network (GLN) is a group of professionals operating globally from 10 countries. It provides a broad spectrum of differentiated services
- focused on delivering value and innovation. We partner with Legal teams across Accenture to build efficiencies and centres of excellence related to Legal services; and through our size, geographic spread and language diversity, the Global Legal Network is able to drive quality, agility and speed in our services, aligned to Accenture’s relentless focus on maximum efficiency and operational effectiveness. Legal Buyside Contracting is a focused legal function for third party contracting. The team is involved with drafting, reviewing and negotiating third party supplier contracts for Accenture and acts as a legal advisory services function leveraging technology to deliver support. Job Summary: Legal Buyside Contracting Role Summary – To provide comprehensive legal support to Procurement and Business teams which includes drafting, reviewing, negotiation and execution of contracts, NDA’s and other documents relevant to procurement support in accordance with company policies and procedures, applicable laws and customer requirements. Provide advisory support to procurement and business teams by driving the creation of templates, standardize the templates, maintain and continuously improve the standard contracts templates and procedures for complex buyside deals in accordance with changing laws and company policies. Develop specialized subject-matter expertise in support area to seamlessly address any potential risks or issues. Specific Responsibilities aligned to Role Draft, review and negotiate high value and high complex supplier/buyside agreements and similar/related documentation with Accenture suppliers, to procure various goods and services including but not limited to Contactors, Human Resources Support, IT & Telecom, Marketing & Communications, Workplace Support (Facilities & Services), Software as a Service etc. in accordance with Accenture’s supplier’s contracting standards, applicable laws, and business requirements. Address complex contract queries and matters regarding contract negotiations, obligations and revisions. Identify risks and issues, suggest alternatives that lead to the best solutions. In this regard effectively manage the internal stakeholders such as deal teams, Solution Architects, Procurement, HR, Workplace, Finance, Marketing & Communications etc., Strategize with company executives prior to vendor negotiations and represent the company’s interests and liaise directly with vendor negotiating teams for legal point on complex contract reviews with high stakes for the company. Act as a point of contact from legal and work closely with the stakeholders to help them understand the contractual clauses in terms of interpretation and its applicability in the contract basis the business opportunity. Advise the Business from legal perspective to address the potential contractual risks that may pose as risks to Accenture business operations. Conduct gap analysis and create legal risk assessment by identifying and flagging potential risks to Accenture and/or clauses which are non-negotiable. Provide recommendations to Business and other related stakeholders to sensitize them on the extent of risk Accenture exposes itself in context of the services and to minimize or mitigate such risks effectively. Educate and bring awareness to the Business teams and other relevant stakeholders with respect to vendor contracting practice and risk management issues Structure the legal transactions to be most advantageous from a contracting and business perspective and manage escalations Autonomously works across all categories and complexities of contractual agreements with vendor/clients deals including reviewing, advising and negotiating legal issues. Assign & Manage Tasks to the team. Manages escalations of serious or unresolved issues in accordance with prescribed guidelines and ensures all interested parties are kept informed and escalation controlled. Responsible for consultation and escalation to a senior director, of contractual, business or resource positioning issues which are not solved satisfactorily by the project team in a timely manner. Generic Responsibilities Collaborate with other functional leads, sub leads to strategize and develop additional capabilities and create efficiencies within the team Manage the team and performance related aspects of the team (not applicable to individuals working as an independent contributor) Supervise the management of Share Point and communication records, ensure creation of checklists and other process documents Effective management of team, including execution of performance management of direct reportees, sub leads, rewarding high performance and correcting deficiencies, demonstrate ability to manage conflict effectively and achieve required team utilization levels Regularly conducts audit of the work done by the team members, provides reports to the leadership on the gaps observed. Responsible for ensuring such gaps are closed by the respective team members. Understand company's approval processes in context of the services and ensure that all stakeholders are timely engaged and informed on the relevant process including understanding the Code of Business Ethics (COBE), Data Privacy &, Information Security Anti-Corruption Laws and related policies and apply the same to ensure compliance and manage the Accenture deals within the procurement or Corporate Functions domain. Create and develop training materials for the team as well as to the internal stakeholders to ensure transactions are completed in accordance with applicable company policies, procedures and local laws. Work with the leadership team closely to identify and implement new trainings for the team. Lead, support, promote and implement initiatives and trainings within the group. Develop and implement internal best practices, lessons learnt, playbook and toolkits, and packaged knowledge on various vendor contracting and business issues. Stay updated on the leadership vision and developments affecting the company, its clients, and industries and orchestrate the information to incorporate it into company’s vendor contracting practices. Provide Legal support in the review of local & global Data Privacy initiatives. Identify risks according to local law and Accenture policies and flag potential issues. Identify process improvements and effectively lead the team in developing/drafting of guidelines, handbooks, know how material, checklists and process/tools associated documents (global/regional and local) for standardizing the process. Collaborate with tech teams in development of new tool or enhancement of existing ones Drive and manage the recruitment process for the team. Act as a point of contact from the team and closely work with HR in terms of conducting interviews. Provide coaching and mentoring to junior members of the team, effective management of direct reports and team; quick conflict resolution, provide feedback to team members and drive talent discussions for the team Commit to ‘give back’ to GLN/Legal Management Level Description Complexity: Requires identifying and assessing complex problems for area of responsibility. Requires adherence to strategic direction set by senior management when establishing near-term goals. - medium sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role). Bachelor’s degree in Law Certifications and Membership: Contract related global professional certification considered a plus Work Experience: Minimum of 13 years of experience at law firm or as in-house counsel and/or in legal outsourcing Knowledge and Skill Requirements: Expert level understanding of both commercial and legal contractual risks and displays ability to provide business-oriented legal advice Fluent in English with strong oral and written skills Experience in managing end-to-end projects and teams on function specific processes and/or areas, work with internal and external teams, and understands delivery requirements Demonstrate excellent interpersonal skills, is detail-oriented, has sound judgement, is adaptable, demonstrate promptness, accuracy, and consistency with the activities supported, and drive tasks to closure, has strong time management, prioritization, organizational skills Build trust-based relationships by delivering on commitments, ability to work under pressure, with exposure to senior management Effectively manage priorities and stakeholder expectations Able to effectively influence senior management. title: Ethics and Compliance Counsel Data Privacy Specialist
jobDescription: Role Summary The Compliance & Ethics Counsel Specialist for Data Privacy is responsible for conducting privacy reviews and supporting the implementation of the global data privacy program. This role requires regular communication and collaboration with internal stakeholders and external counsel. While the position involves considerable independent work, strong teamwork and communication skills are essential. Additionally, it contributes to process improvements, conducts privacy research, supports data subject rights and regulatory inquiries, and presents project updates to leadership and business teams. Responsibilities aligned to the role Draft, design, align and improve compliance processes and templates to implement different data privacy laws and other requirements that come into effect. Coordinate with different stakeholders to understand and collect process requirements and advise on approaches. Act as a project manager for new initiatives and introduce measures for existing processes and ad-hoc initiatives. Conduct data privacy assessments, such as local country risk assessments, privacy reviews and/or DP Impact Assessments, to ensure compliance with data privacy program and regulations. Support ventures & acquisitions due diligence activities, and policy administration. Understand the contractual principles required to draft, review, and assist in negotiation data privacy schedules for contractual arrangements. Monitor legal developments, regulatory changes, and global trends related to data privacy, and analyze their impact on business operations and prepare internal guidance, communications, and training materials. Draft internal support documents. Identify and support subject access/individual rights request responses in alignment with internal policies and procedures. Understand relevant Accenture policies and their application to the data privacy area, and Accenture’s business operations, regulatory environment and potential data privacy risks in regulated areas. Develop training for team members, Legal and other Accenture functions on data privacy processes or regulatory requirements. Understand the different CORE (Compliance, Operations, Regulatory & Ethics) areas and the surrounding issues and statutory regulation. Build credibility and effective relationships internally within the Legal team. Support senior data privacy counsels in operational and advisory matters.. Serve as tier 1 support to inquiries about data privacy and escalate issues appropriately. Knowledge and Skill Requirements Law degree with 3–4 years of experience in data privacy. Understanding of regulatory principles governing data privacy at a global level. Fluent in English with excellent written, oral, and presentation skills. Ability to understand and design process flows and metrics. IAPP certifications, such as CIPP/E or similar are a plus. Effectively stakeholders management skills, including experience with senior leadership. Skilled in legal research, including the use of Gen AI tools. Proficiency in Microsoft Share Point, Excel, Power Point, and Word; Power BI proficiency is an advantage. Sound judgment in applying company policies, identifying risks, and escalating issues in a timely manner. Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast‑paced environment. Excellent time management, prioritization, and analytical skills. title: Security Operations Center Incident Manager
jobDescription:
The Security Operations Center (SOC) Manager serves as the deputy to the SOC Senior Manager and provides operational and strategic leadership within Accenture’s Global Security Operations Centers organization. This role is responsible for ensuring performance and consistency across the three core ASOC pillars: Threat Monitoring, Building Monitoring and Alarms, and ASOC Calls. The SOC Manager also serves as the primary Travel Security Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the ASOC, helping ensure Accenture travelers in high-risk destinations are supported. This position is based in Pune, India and reports directly to the SOC Senior Manager. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead response efforts for complex, high-impact incidents affecting Accenture employees, travelers, facilities, and global business operations to include notify, assist and direct external emergency personnel and internal resources as necessary. Manage threat monitoring involving extreme weather, geopolitical instability, crime, terrorism, civil unrest, medical emergencies, and travel-related disruptions. Ensure threat monitoring is assessed, escalated, coordinated, and communicated in alignment with the GP&S Escalation Model and SOC Standard Operating Procedures. Liaise with SOC stakeholders such as Regional Protective Services, Executive Protection/Events, and Intelligence to ensure threat monitoring triggers meet their organizational needs. Establish and enforce standards for high-quality writing across ASOC products. Maintain situational awareness of high-risk travel regions and ensure delivery of timely alerts and advisories to traveling employees and stakeholders, including Mobility and Human Resources. Provide operational oversight and decision-making during active incidents to ensure timely, accurate, and effective outcomes. Act as a trusted operational partner to GP&S stakeholders and regional security leadership. Responsible for training SOC personnel to ensure competency and readiness when supporting GP&S in incident and incident response activities. Conduct thorough After-Action Reviews (AARs) after an incident and document areas of improvement and track SOC action items through completion. Conduct regular SOP reviews and updates to ensure policies and instructions provide up-to-date and clear guidance to enable an efficient response by SOC personnel. Job Requirements: Ability to work outside of business hours on short notice during critical events to include, nights, weekends, and or holidays. Bachelor’s degree Minimum of 5 years of work experience in military, law enforcement, intelligence, or corporate security environments supporting security incident monitoring, communications, and response. Preferred Skills Bias for action and strong attention to detail. Strong writing skills and experience preparing communications to be shared with senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing high stress and impactful incidents. Experienced and independent communicator, both verbal and written. Experience with emergency response protocols and processes. Bilingual (languages in addition to English). Experience with threat monitoring and emergency communication tools such as Factal, Sam Desk, Everbridge, ISOS, etc. Experience with CCure, Genetec or Sureview. Proficient in Microsoft Windows and Office Suite. Team with more senior Contracting lawyers in supporting more complex contracts and deal structures. Act, and continuously evolve as, a knowledgeable and relevant advisor on legal and commercial risks associated with transactions. You will support Avanade, a joint venture between Accenture and Microsoft, which is a leader in cloud services, AI, and sustainable industry solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem. Avanade focuses on mid-market clients with revenues ranging from $500 million to $5 billion, providing agile and high-value IT services. In this role, you will advise business leadership on legal risks and guide clients through contracting processes. You will drive growth by winning clients with creativity and innovative legal strategies, even in smaller deals. High agility and urgency are essential to manage a high volume of deals with shorter cycles and shifting priorities. You will make informed decisions and take calculated risks to propel the business forward. Your role will involve balancing ease of collaboration with the need to avoid undue risk to Avanade. You will also balance the aggressive expansion of Avanade’s recurring platform business with providing customized, high-touch legal services for select clients who prefer traditional contract negotiations. As an independent advisor on legal and commercial risks, you will support Legal, Business, and Sales Leadership in shaping Avanade’s mid-market strategies. We achieve this by being bold, fresh, passionate, and optimistic. You will oversee the delivery of a variety of in-house legal services that support the business in achieving its goals while ensuring all areas of risk and compliance are managed effectively. You will collaborate with business management, business development executives, contract coordinators, internal business units, and other support functions. Key

title: S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Transformation - Transformation Coach - Senior Manager
jobDescription: Senior Manager – Transformation Office – Transformation Coach Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from technology Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network Areas of Work: Transformation Management, Transformation Coaching, Value Realization, Agentic AI Level: Senior Manager (Level 6) Location: Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad Years of Experience: 12 to 17 years Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture Are you passionate about shaping the early direction of large-scale transformation programs and building organizational muscles to sustain them? Do you excel at guiding senior leaders and cross-functional teams to define ways of working, embed governance practices, and drive transformation with discipline and clarity? If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation and take on a senior leadership role, guiding global clients on their most complex transformation journeys — working at the heart of our clients’ most ambitious programs to set the tone, build the foundation, and enable lasting transformation outcomes, now enhanced by the power of Agentic AI. The Practice – A Brief Sketch Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, redefining business models and delivery approaches. As a Senior Manager, you will be deployed at the critical early stages of transformation programs — shaping direction, enabling teams, and embedding the practices that make transformation stick. Here are some of the key initiatives you will drive: Establishing Strategic Direction for Early-Stage Transformation: Partnering with senior client leadership to define transformation vision, governance frameworks, and ways of working at program inception. Transformation Coaching & Team Enablement: Embedding alongside client teams to coach leaders and program workstreams on transformation management best practices, decision-making structures, and accountability models. Agentic AI-Powered Transformation Management: Identifying and deploying Agentic AI solutions within transformation programs to automate tracking, analysis, and realization of business value. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Manager who brings deep expertise in Transformation Management and a hands-on track record as a Transformation Coach. The ideal candidate excels at working in the early, ambiguous stages of large transformation programs — helping clients shape direction, define how the program will be managed, establish ways of working, and build the governance structures needed to execute with confidence. You will work closely with C-suite stakeholders, transformation leads, and program workstream owners to coach teams, embed best practices, and apply Agentic AI to accelerate program management maturity — ensuring measurable business outcomes are governed and realized throughout the transformation lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Transformation Coaching & Early-Stage Strategy Formulation Orchestrate Transformation Change– Guide and orchestrate enterprise-wide change across business units in close coordination with talent/HR teams, ensuring transformation approaches are shaped to client context, maturity, and archetype — enabling the organization to own and sustain the change rather than depending on externally imposed frameworks. Steer Culture & Accountability – Embed transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement, ensuring governance is actively practiced. Coach Leadership Teams – Guide senior leaders and workstream heads on transformation management principles, enabling effective decision-making, alignment, and disciplined execution. Build Capability – Build Transformation Management capability by enabling standard transformation orchestration guidelines, structured governance, change adoption, stakeholder alignment, and value realization to sustainably drive strategic change. Lead Transformation & Value Management Set up & Run TO – Set up and run Transformation Management Offices (TMO) / Value Realization Offices (VRO) for large-scale client engagements, owning governance, reporting, and value tracking end-to-end. Value Discovery & KPIs – Conduct and facilitate value discovery workshops to identify business objectives, key value drivers, and measurable KPIs during the business blueprint phase. Build detailed business cases for transformation initiatives, working with business and functional leaders to track and report actual performance against targets. Establish Program Governance – Design and embed program structures including decision cadences, escalation models, accountability frameworks, and standardized ways of working (meetings, reporting, RAID, decision registers). Embedding Best Practices & Sustaining Transformation Build Playbooks & Toolkits – Develop and institutionalize transformation playbooks, toolkits, and SOPs tailored to client context and maturity. Facilitate Health & Risk Reviews – Lead structured sessions to assess transformation health, identify risks, and co-create corrective actions. Drive Agentic AI-Powered Transformation Apply hands-on expertise in AI Agents and agentic architecture to automate and accelerate transformation management activities — including status tracking, risk identification, value analysis, and reporting. Identify opportunities within client programs where Agentic AI can meaningfully improve program governance, decision-making, and value realization speed. Articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption. Stay current with the evolving landscape of AI agent frameworks and proactively recommend their application within ongoing engagements. Stakeholder Engagement & Client Advisory Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and senior technology leaders, architecting and guiding transformation journeys with authority and clarity. Apply a cross-enterprise perspective spanning business and technology stakeholders, navigating ambiguity to pursue a consistent transformation vision. Collaborate with internal team members — business unit leaders, process owners, and IT teams — to capture feedback, align on initiatives, and manage change effectively. Maintain strong internal and client relationships through consistent delivery, proactive communication, and executive-level presence. Core Skillsets Transformation Coaching & Ways of Working Ability to orchestrate and steer enterprise-wide transformation change — designing bespoke approaches tailored to client context, maturity, and archetype rather than applying generic frameworks. Experience designing and embedding program governance structures — decision cadences, escalation models, accountability frameworks, and standardized ways of working. Demonstrated ability to coach senior leaders on transformation management principles — enabling effective decision-making, alignment, and disciplined execution across workstreams. Skill in embedding transparency, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement — ensuring governance is actively practiced, not just documented. Track record of building transformation playbooks, toolkits, and SOPs — and facilitating structured health and risk reviews to identify execution gaps and co-create corrective actions. Transformation Management & Value Realization Deep expertise in setting up and operating TMOs and VROs — owning governance, reporting, and value tracking end-to-end for large-scale transformation programs. Strong command of KPI frameworks, value trees, business case development, and value discovery — translating business objectives into measurable performance targets. Prior exposure using AI to manage large transformation programs — AI-driven dashboards, intelligent tracking, and analytics to enhance program visibility and value outcomes. Consulting & Advisory Strong consulting foundation — strategic analysis, program management, and C-suite stakeholder engagement across business and technology functions. Facilitation skills across Design Thinking, Value Stream Mapping, and transformation roadmap sessions; trusted advisor capability to navigate ambiguity and resolve cross-functional tensions. Good to Have Skills Transformation Maturity Assessment Familiarity with transformation maturity models and assessment frameworks used to baseline program management capability and track improvement over time. Experience using structured diagnostics to identify program execution risks and recommend governance remediation actions. Agentic AI & AI-Powered Delivery Hands-on experience creating and leveraging AI Agents and agentic architecture in enterprise transformation contexts. Demonstrated ability to identify, deploy, and articulate Agentic AI use cases within ongoing programs. Familiarity with leading AI agent frameworks and LLM-powered workflow automation tools. Industry Depth Good exposure to few of the following industries: Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, or Mining and Resources. Potential to co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, and business intelligence professionals to shape innovative solutions leveraging emerging technologies. Ability to embed responsible business into everything — from how you serve clients to how you operate as a professional. Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen and grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities. title: Acquisitions Legal Counsel Associate Manager
jobDescription:
Global Legal Network is a group of professionals operating globally from 12 countries. It provides a broad spectrum of differentiated services
- focused on delivering value and innovation. We partner with Legal teams across Accenture to build efficiencies and centers of excellence related to Legal services; and through our size, geographic spread and language diversity, the Global Legal Network is able to drive quality, agility and speed in our services, aligned to Accenture’s relentless focus on maximum efficiency and operational effectiveness. Ventures & Acquisitions (V&A) assists in the legal aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures and strategic investment transactions, including due diligence, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating acquisitions documents, the target’s agreements and other documentation, advises on legal risks and mitigation alternatives associated with the transactions. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: We are an equal opportunity employer. We have an unwavering commitment to equality for all. Together, we are acting, we are leading, and we will drive change across the globe. JOB SUMMARY: Complexity: Requires analysis and solving of moderately complex problems. Typically creates new solutions, leveraging and, where needed, adapting existing methods and procedures. Requires understanding of the strategic direction set by senior management as it relates to team goals. Primary upward interaction is with direct supervisor or team leads. Generally, interacts with peers and/or management levels at a client and/or within Accenture. Authority: Requires minimal guidance when determining methods and procedures on new assignments. Impact or Decision: Decisions often impact the team in which they reside and occasionally impact other teams. Scope: Manages medium-small sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Provide legal support to Accenture’s M&A and strategic investment transactions, supporting legal due diligence exercises, identifying risks and mitigation plans, supporting Accenture’s M&A deal attorney in the negotiation of the transactions and the review of transactional documents in collaboration with legal and non-legal professionals supporting M&A and strategic investment transactions. Responsibly provide support to key Accenture M&A stakeholders including M&A deal attorney, Procurement Plus V&A, Contracting, Legal Integration teams and other Legal teams in different geographies. Document, review and draft the terms and conditions of different types of agreements and other documents relating to various target/acquired companies in accordance with company policies and procedures, applicable laws, and stakeholders’ requirements. Collaborate and coordinate with Accenture’s M&A deal attorney, Legal Integration Managers and Procurement Plus V&A Leads on the review of data room materials, in particular executed client, alliance and supplier agreements of the target companies. Train the team members and develop checklists and process documents for pre- and post-acquisition legal support. Directly liaising with internal stakeholders and deal teams on various legal and commercial issues. Maintain contract / subcontract compliance in line with company policies and procedures and ensures issues are resolved. Responsibly works at smaller engagements and/or works within team at a large, complex engagement.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Law. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS: Minimum of 8 years of experience at law firm and/or as in-house counsel and experience in coordinating teamwork (or as individual contributor). Experience in M&A practice with strong knowledge of M&A transactions, due diligence exercises, general corporate business practices, commercial contracting regulations, subcontracting practices and ability to apply skills creatively to diverse stakeholder needs. Demonstrates ability to consistently and responsibly undertake contract drafting to a reasonable standard. Strong time-management, prioritization, organizational, problem solving skills. Displays a high level of responsiveness and follows through on commitments. Detail-oriented, sound judgement, organized, and flexible. Demonstrates a specialized subject-matter experience. BEHAVIOURS AND ATTRIBUTES: Open to work with and understand cross-cultures and locations throughout the Accenture global organization. Understand the value of diversity and recognize the strengths that different styles, innovative perspectives and experiences bring to Accenture. Demonstrate inclusion and respect for all individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, age, disability, culture, social status and/or sexuality. Leader as well as team player, collaborative and persuasive; able to work well with executives and non-executives. Identifies and suggests improved/innovative work processes or ways to improve client (internal and external) service. Suggests options for resolving issues and improving quality of work. Adapts to change quickly with an eagerness to try and learn new things, and maintains flexibility and resilience in changing situations. WORK REQUIREMENTS: Travel may be required. title: Contract Associate - NRR 4542
jobDescription:
Accenture is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Accenture will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Accenture encourages applicants of all ages. Global Legal Network (GLN) is a group of professionals operating globally from 10 countries. It provides a broad spectrum of differentiated services
- focused on delivering value and innovation. We partner with Legal teams across Accenture to build efficiencies and centres of excellence related to Legal services; and through our size, geographic spread and language diversity, the Global Legal Network is able to drive quality, agility and speed in our services, aligned to Accenture’s relentless focus on maximum efficiency and operational effectiveness. CORE and Global Services (CGS) is a group of legal professionals working and supporting different legal areas such as Compliance, Regulatory Offerings, Ethics, Procurement, Corporate Matters and the Services Areas aligned with the new offerings and technologies such as Strategy & Consulting, Interactive, Technology, Security and Operations. Procurement, NDA and Colocation & Software License Management- Support DCN Legal team within CGS functional area in India: Procurement, NDA and Colocation Role Summary- Performing the due diligence, documenting and reviewing terms and conditions and negotiating through procurement contracts/sub-contracts, proposals, agreements, statements of work, NDAs and other documents relating to various operating groups; and assist in performing due diligence to ensure process compliance and risk mitigation in accordance with company policies and procedures, applicable laws, and customer requirements. License Management Role Summary – To support the Legal Services team in reviewing the End User License Agreement/License terms of various commercial and non-commercial software requested for installation within India Delivery Centre and to review, evaluate and recommend whether Accenture has right to reuse/redistribute assets such as software, tools, applications developed by Accenture, based on related third-party licenses and associated IP rights, and to define the scope and limits of Accenture's use and reuse of such assets. Management Level Description Complexity: Requires solving of routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines. Interaction is within own team and direct supervisor. Authority: Requires detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments. Impact or Decision Impact: Decisions impact own work. Required Skills Technical Skills • Treasury and cash management. • Financial risk management. • Liquidity forecasting. • Investment management fundamentals. • Banking operations and payment systems. • Regulatory and statutory reporting. • Advanced Excel and financial modeling. • Treasury Management Systems (TMS), SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar platforms. Process Improvement & Transformation • Drive automation and digitization initiatives within treasury operations. • Implement cash forecasting and treasury management tools. • Identify opportunities for process standardization and efficiency improvements. • Support finance transformation projects and strategic initiative Leadership Skills • Stakeholder management. • Strategic thinking. • Analytical and problem-solving skills. • Project and change management. • Team leadership and coaching. • Strong presentation and communication abilities. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 3 • Cash forecast accuracy. • Liquidity coverage ratio compliance. • Timeliness of claims funding. • Treasury policy compliance. • Reduction in banking and transaction costs. • Working capital optimization. • Audit and regulatory compliance results. • Treasury process automation achievements. Roles and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
•Cash & Liquidity Management • Monitor daily cash positions across all bank accounts. • Manage short-term and long-term liquidity requirements. • Prepare rolling cash flow forecasts and funding plans. • Ensure adequate liquidity for claims payments and operational expenses. • Optimize cash balances and working capital. Treasury Operations • Manage banking relationships and banking services. • Review and approve payment runs and treasury transactions. • Oversee fund transfers, wire payments, and investment settlements. • Maintain treasury policies, procedures, and controls. • Ensure segregation of duties and compliance with treasury governance standards. Investment & Capital Management • Coordinate with the Investment team on surplus fund deployment. • Monitor investment liquidity and maturity profiles. • Support capital planning and solvency management activities. • Analyze investment performance and treasury impacts. 1 • Assist in managing debt facilities and financing arrangements. Insurance-Specific Treasury Activities • Support claim funding requirements and catastrophe event liquidity planning. • Manage reinsurance settlement cash flows and recoverable. • Coordinate with actuarial and finance teams on reserve funding requirements. • Monitor regulatory capital and statutory liquidity requirements. • Support rating agency and regulatory reporting activities. Financial Risk Management • Identify and manage foreign exchange, interest rate, and liquidity risks. • Develop risk mitigation strategies and hedging recommendations. • Monitor treasury compliance limits and policy thresholds. • Conduct scenario analysis and stress testing. Reporting & Analysis • Prepare treasury dashboards and management reports. • Analyze cash flow trends and forecast variances. • Present treasury performance metrics to leadership. • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities. Governance, Compliance & Audit • Ensure compliance with insurance regulations and corporate policies. • Support internal and external audits. • Maintain treasury documentation and approval matrices. • Strengthen internal controls and process governance. Additionally, you must possess the following skills- • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and lead strategic Finance Transformation engagements. • Strong leadership, people management, and mentoring skills with experience leading cross-functional and global teams. • Professional certifications in Black Line, SAP, or Finance Transformation methodologies will be an added advantage. Experience running multi-geography operations/teams Roles and
